note: The British Indian Ocean Territory: every visitor needs a permit from the Territory's Administration in London before travelling (taken as a visa, British citizens included), valid for the outer islands only; Diego Garcia is closed to anyone without a connection to the military facility. Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policies of British Overseas Territories
sources.said: British Indian Ocean Territory – Visitors must obtain a valid permit before travelling. Permits are issued by British Indian Ocean Territory Administration at the Foreign and Commonwealth Office in London .
